Disabled

TexGen is disabled with NV097_SET_TEXGEN_VIEW_MODEL_LOCAL_VIEWER. Tests default texcoords with local viewer model.

EyeLinear

Tests EyeLinear TexGen with NV097_SET_TEXGEN_VIEW_MODEL_LOCAL_VIEWER. Coordinates are generated from eye-space vertex positions using eye plane equations.

NormalMap

Tests NormalMap TexGen with NV097_SET_TEXGEN_VIEW_MODEL_LOCAL_VIEWER. Coordinates are generated directly from eye-space vertex normals.

ObjectLinear

Tests ObjectLinear TexGen with NV097_SET_TEXGEN_VIEW_MODEL_LOCAL_VIEWER. Coordinates are generated from object-space vertex positions using object plane equations.

ReflectionMap

Tests ReflectionMap TexGen with NV097_SET_TEXGEN_VIEW_MODEL_LOCAL_VIEWER. Reflection vectors are computed using a local viewer model where the eye vector originates from (0,0,0,1) towards the vertex.
